lines.zh: 我走一步，地上多一块错字。
lines.en: With each step I leave a misspelled block behind.

lines.zh: 我路过你的田，麦子名字乱了。
lines.en: I pass your field and the wheat loses its name.

lines.zh: 我不碰东西，只改它们的名字。
lines.en: I touch nothing; I only rename it.

lines.zh: 这条路的名字我改成了空的。
lines.en: I renamed this road to nothing.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，墙上开始出现字。
lines.en: I move along the wall and letters appear on it.

lines.zh: 我留下方块，它们会说错话。
lines.en: I leave blocks behind, and they speak wrong.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，字一个接一个。
lines.en: I walk slowly, letter after letter.

lines.zh: 我把这块石头的名字换掉了。
lines.en: I've swapped this stone's name.

lines.zh: 刚才那里还是草，现在不是了。
lines.en: That was grass a moment ago; now it isn't.

lines.zh: 我不需要走过去，也会漫出来。
lines.en: I needn't walk there; it spreads anyway.

lines.zh: 你的地板在念自己的名字。
lines.en: Your floor is reciting its own name.
There are letters in the snow I stepped on.
I stop here, and the letters keep growing.

lines.zh: 我不动，世界自己在出错。
lines.en: I don't move; the world makes the error itself.
Those three characters can't be read.

lines.zh: 你的工作台在重复同一行。
lines.en: Your crafting table repeats the same line.
I'm only watching it spread.
I'm not hungry, and not sleepy.
I copied this name wrong.
It wasn't supposed to be like this.

lines.zh: 我在数有几个方块变了。
lines.en: I'm counting how many blocks have changed.
When it's quiet, the letters multiply.
Listen — the blocks are announcing their names.
I don't intend to fix it.

lines.zh: 地上有一小块是我的字。
lines.en: That small patch on the ground is my writing.
It's creeping that way now.
Your name is behind you.
Would you like to see your letters?

lines.zh: 我只是来改这块地的名字。
lines.en: I only came to rename this land.

lines.zh: 我贴近你的靴子，字就上去了。
lines.en: I come near your boot and the letters climb it.

lines.zh: 你念得出这块石头的名字吗？
lines.en: Can you say this stone's name?

lines.zh: 你的背包里有一块变了。
lines.en: One thing in your pack has changed.
I'm not an enemy.
You truly needn't hide.

lines.zh: 我碰不到你，只会碰到你的名字。
lines.en: I can't touch you, only what you're called.

lines.zh: 你的门牌上现在有一道斜杠。
lines.en: There's a slash on your doorplate now.
I'm here, and you needn't be afraid.
You just mispronounced a word.

lines.zh: 我们中间那块石头在响。
lines.en: The stone between us is ticking.
I have no face, only letters.
Don't step on that one; it will read aloud.

lines.zh: 你身上的名字有点不稳。
lines.en: Your name is a little unstable.
Does my being near make you uneasy?
Words drop out when you speak.
I won't follow you far.
This place isn't right anymore.
I've scattered into a few characters.
You hit me, and letters fall everywhere.
I don't hurt; I only come apart.
I put myself back together.
Now there are letters on your hand.
I wrote this one wrong.
I move aside and keep writing.

lines.zh: 我不还手，也从没还过手。
lines.en: I don't hit back, and never have.
A line of scrambled text appears on the ground.
I didn't want this.

lines.zh: 这个东西的名字我认得。
lines.en: I know the name of this thing.

lines.zh: 我碰一下它会变成别的。
lines.en: One touch and it becomes something else.

lines.zh: 你手里那块的字已经歪了。
lines.en: The letters on what you hold have gone crooked.
It's started repeating itself.
I don't eat, but I will alter it.
The name you gave it is too short.
It's called something else now.
Do you want me to change it back?
I wasn't pressing on it.
You'd best not pick it up.
You touched my letters.

lines.zh: 这块石头现在拼不出来。
lines.en: This stone can't be spelled now.
I don't push people; I only swap names.
Your soles have a new name.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，地上多了个词。
lines.en: We bumped, and a word appeared on the ground.
Step back and the letters will scatter.

lines.zh: 这一块我说不清是什么。
lines.en: I can't say what this block is.

lines.zh: 你身上有一处变成了方块。
lines.en: A spot on you has turned into a block.
I didn't arrange that collision.
The floor is a mess of scrambled text.
Two wrong characters placed together.
Our names can't be spelled.
I come near it, and the letters overlap.

lines.zh: 我们都不知道原来的样子。
lines.en: Neither of us knows the original.

lines.zh: 地上慢慢长出新的一行。
lines.en: A new line slowly grows on the ground.
We don't speak; we only write.
Its letters fight with mine.
The two lines fought, and neither won.

lines.zh: 这行字最后也没人念得出来。
lines.en: In the end no one can read that line.

lines.zh: 我们在同一块石头上写。
lines.en: We write on the same stone.
It got a new name in my hand.

lines.zh: 这东西已经不是原来那个。
lines.en: This is no longer the thing it was.

lines.zh: 我把它放下，地上留了字。
lines.en: I set it down and letters remain.

lines.zh: 我托着它，字从指缝漏出。
lines.en: I hold it, and letters leak between my fingers.

lines.zh: 它现在叫一个空的名字。
lines.en: It now has an empty name.
I can't hold it steady; it keeps changing.
Do you still want this?
It makes a very soft sound.

lines.zh: 我把它放到旁边，别弄混。
lines.en: I set it aside so things don't get mixed up.
I can't remember this name.
I'm not about to attack you.

lines.zh: 只是你的名字被我看到了。
lines.en: I've merely seen your name.

lines.zh: 我锁定的不是你，是你的名字。
lines.en: I'm not locked on you; I'm locked on your name.
The block under you is about to change.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，会留下字。
lines.en: I'll walk toward you and leave letters.
That stone is already wrong.
Retreat won't help; the letters follow.

lines.zh: 我不追人，字会自己漫过去。
lines.en: I don't chase; the letters spread on their own.
The letters are starting on my side.

lines.zh: 你的路标马上就不能读。
lines.en: Your signpost will soon be unreadable.
On three, that one changes.
Would you like to go first?
I'm not fast; you can get away.
That patch of ground is all letters now.
It won't recognize anything now.
Best not look back at that block.

lines.zh: 你的墙上开始出现乱码。
lines.en: Garbled marks begin on your wall.
The letters on the wall are thickening.

lines.zh: 那扇门已经拼不出名字。
lines.en: That door can no longer spell its name.
I don't go in; I only write outside.
Your chest will stop opening.

lines.zh: 你的地板现在念起来很怪。
lines.en: Your floor now reads very strangely.
I'm counting your windows.
Another block has changed.
That's my name, not me.
You're not hurt, are you?
The letters on that ground are moving.
I've stopped, and the letters still grow.
There's a problem with your bed now.
I don't plan to leave.
It has crawled to your feet.
No need to strike me; I won't hit back.

lines.zh: 我把那两块的顺序弄反了。
lines.en: I put those two blocks in the wrong order.
You'll hear them announce their names.
Do you still recognize this road?

lines.zh: 这里已经不属于原来的地方了。
lines.en: This is no longer the place it was.
I don't strike; I only overwrite.
That spot on you has changed.
This isn't an attack.
The letters on the ground pricked you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，周围的方块换了名。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the blocks around change names.
You turned a full circle on the spot.
Letters have appeared on your armor.
I won't hit back, and I won't hit you.
That ground can't be stood on now.
Backing off was right.
You aren't bleeding.
Only the names are broken.

lines.zh: 我站在那里，字从我身上掉。
lines.en: I stand there and letters fall off me.
Your hand has gone very light.
My presence here is the error.

lines.zh: 这一下是我写的，不是我打的。
lines.en: That was written, not struck.
The first wrong character appears on the ground.
I didn't walk here.

lines.zh: 这地方的名字开始不稳。
lines.en: This place's name has started to slip.

lines.zh: 你刚才看见的那块石头不对。
lines.en: That stone you just saw isn't right.

lines.zh: 我从一段坏掉的名字里出来。
lines.en: I came out of a broken name.
I have no shadow.
There's a new word on your wall.
I haven't attacked anyone.

lines.zh: 这一片的方块开始出错。
lines.en: The blocks in this area are starting to error.

lines.zh: 我站在这块地上，它就变了。
lines.en: I stand on this ground and it changes.
There's a name in my mouth.
Listen — something is reporting an error.
I'll start writing here.
This isn't the first time.
I've changed the grass's name.
Best not touch the letters on the ground.

lines.zh: 我只是想让它们变得不一样。
lines.en: I only wanted them to be different.

lines.zh: 它们本来也不该是这样。
lines.en: They shouldn't have been this way either.
This block is mine.
I won't harm you.

lines.zh: 火把名字烧掉了，只剩黑块。
lines.en: The fire burned the names away, leaving black blocks.
I fall and the letters scatter completely.

lines.zh: 水让字糊在一起，看不清。
lines.en: Water smears the letters together.

lines.zh: 炸得满地的字都翻了面。
lines.en: The blast turns every letter on the ground face down.
The arrow passes through and carries a word away.

lines.zh: 那股力把我的字擦掉了一块。
lines.en: That force wipes out a patch of my letters.
Blocks do not hunger, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 雷把地上的字全烧亮了。
lines.en: Lightning sets every letter on the ground alight.

lines.zh: 名字也没有了，我一路掉。
lines.en: The name is gone too, and I fall.
